5th Municipal District (Patisia, Agios Eleftherios) — Athens, Greece

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

This district covers Agios Eleftherios, Patisia, Rizoupoli and Prompona. Patisia has a multi-year, well-documented pattern of serious problems: a 2016 Vice report on Kato Patisia, a 2018 LiFO "fear map" naming Patisia as an area residents avoid after dark, a March 2022 knife attack on two women in Ano Patisia, a November 2023 bust of a major drug-trafficking operation involving roughly 24 kilograms of cannabis and cocaine, and a June 2026 knifepoint robbery on Acharnon Street. Rizoupoli and Prompona are quiet residential areas with no documented incidents in the sources checked. Given the sustained, multi-year documentation specific to Patisia, day is rated yellow and night is rated red for the district overall. Sources checked: Vice.gr; LiFO; Lawandorder.gr; in.gr; MegaTV; Anoihti Poli; Tlife.gr.
